messages:
ap_vendor_nl: Hi Redwood, invoice 2026-NL-2100 was paid with 21% VAT but our local VAT team says it should be reverse-charged. Our VAT: NL123456782B01. Can you reissue without VAT? Also our CFO asked if Redwood can gross-up for a potential 2% withholding on the final payout to an affiliate.

maya_finance: Thanks. Please confirm buyer entity on PO and attach the invoice PDF. We'll reissue if buyer is EU entity and VAT verified. For gross-up we need the contract clause and TRC; we don't approve open-ended gross-ups.

ap_vendor_nl: Invoice billed to Redwood B.V. PDF attached. Contract clause screenshot uploaded to drive link.

peter_tax: Quick note: reverse-charge OK if buyer is VAT-registered. For gross-up: provide TRC and exact statutory basis for 2% withholding. Without TRC we may withhold per local rules. Formula for vendor reference: gross = net / (1 - rate).

legal_ops: We won't accept uncapped gross-ups. Require TRC + prior written approval. Recommend vendor request TRC and resubmit a formal gross-up calc.

billing-bot: Reissue job created: 2026-NL-2100 -> draft 2026-NL-2100-RC (job id 2335007799). Payment hold flag set pending TRC or confirmation.

ap_vendor_nl: Got it, we'll upload TRC within 3 business days. Thank you.
